title: build-main
responsibility: Owns the build-main build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: releaseDefine.env
inputs.description: Environment mapping with the optional public HARNESS_RELEASE_HUB_ORIGIN value.

outputs.name: desktopNodeOptions
outputs.type: { target: "node"; format: "cjs"; external: string[]; plugins: BunPlugin[]; outdir: string; sourcemap: "external"; }
outputs.description: Default Bun options for the Node CommonJS bundles, including the JSONC parser plugin, external Electron and Playwright, dist output, and external sourcemaps.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The command refuses an invalid release Hub origin, a failed bundle build, or an output that fails node --check. System and filesystem errors propagate.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The requested release origin is missing or Bun rejects the bundle build.

inputs.name: releaseDefine.env
inputs.description: Environment mapping with the optional public HARNESS_RELEASE_HUB_ORIGIN value.

inputs.name: releaseDefine.required
inputs.description: Require a release origin for signed packaging. Defaults to false for development builds.

outputs.name: releaseDefine
outputs.description: A definition that compiles the canonical HTTPS Hub origin into the main bundle, or an empty mapping for development.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The supplied release origin is not a canonical remote HTTPS origin.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Packaging requires a release origin and HARNESS_RELEASE_HUB_ORIGIN is absent.

inputs.name: buildDesktopMain.define
inputs.description: Definitions for main.cjs, resolved from the build environment by the caller.

inputs.name: buildDesktopMain.outdir
inputs.description: Destination for main.cjs, preload.cjs, and their maps. Defaults to dist.

outputs.name: buildDesktopMain
outputs.description: Writes both Node bundles and checks their JavaScript syntax.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Bundling or node --check failed, or an input or output could not be accessed.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Bun could not build main.cjs or preload.cjs.
